Hi Samir — great to hear from you. Thanks for the context — short answers up front, longer below and attached a concise rate card PDF (rwd-embeddings-ratecard-v2.pdf) and a simple CSV estimate based on your volumes.

Baseline pricing (hosted API):
- Standard 768-dim embedding (rwd-embed-small-v1): $0.00035 per vector (per inference call).
- Higher-quality 1,024-dim (rwd-embed-large-v1): $0.00065 per vector.
- We also support community/open variants in the catalog (open-embed-1024) — pricing varies; we can expose per-token conversions on request.

Per-vector vs per-token: Redwood bills embeddings as a per-embedding call (per-vector). For models that report tokens, we provide a conversion table for estimate purposes in the attached CSV, but customers are charged on the vector unit for hosted endpoints.

Dimensions and storage: vector dimension affects both cost and storage/transfer. We recommend 768 for most product search use-cases; 1,024 can give incremental quality but at ~85–90% higher cost.

Discounts / commit guidance:
- Typical volume tiers: 0–10M, 10–30M, 30M+.
- Standard self-serve customers: no discount; committed customers: sliding 8–18% depending on term and ARR commitment.
- For a 12-month committed contract at ~40M/mo, we'd typically look at a mid-teens discount.

Next steps: I attached a quick estimate and our rate card. If you can confirm which model (768 vs 1024) you'd prefer and a target commit, I can put together a formal quote and a PO-ready SOW.
